Chief Complaint
Follow-up for Hodgkin lymphoma.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his Hodgkin lymphoma. He is currently undergoing active chemotherapy. He reports that he has been managing the side effects of his current treatment regimen. He denies any acute distress or new symptoms since his last evaluation. He states that his energy levels are stable and he is able to perform most activities of daily living.

Medication List
- Chemotherapy (current regimen)
- Ondansetron 8mg as needed for nausea
- Prednisone 20mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. He appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Physical examination reveals no new lymphadenopathy or palpable masses. Skin is clear without significant changes.

Assessment
1. Hodgkin lymphoma, currently undergoing active chemotherapy.

Plan
1. Continue current chemotherapy regimen as directed by the oncology team.
2. Monitor for any adverse reactions to treatment.
3. Follow up in the clinic as scheduled for continued management of Hodgkin lymphoma.

Electronically signed,
K. Nguyen, PA-C
